title: Netherlands
description: Netherlands deep dive: inflation, food prices, housing, energy, unemployment, interest rates, FX, tourism and weather since 2025.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='cpi_inflation_pct' AND source='cbs' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='food_cpi_inflation_pct' AND source='cbs' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='house_price_index' AND source='cbs' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='unemployment_rate_pct' AND source='cbs' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='gov_bond_10y_pct' AND source='ecb' ORDER BY period_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ts AS time, 1/rate AS value FROM fx_rate WHERE base='USD' AND quote='EUR' AND source='frankfurter' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Netherlands — 5 cities, current temperature
panels.description: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht, Eindhoven — latest reading.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.city)
  w.city AS "City", c.lat, c.lon, w.temp_c AS "Temp °C", w.humidity AS "Humidity %",
  w.wind_kph AS "Wind km/h", w.aqi_eu AS "AQI", w.ts AS "Observed"
FROM weather_current w JOIN city c ON c.city = w.city
WHERE w.city IN ('Amsterdam','Rotterdam','The Hague','Utrecht','Eindhoven') AND w.ts > now() - interval '3 hours'
ORDER BY w.city, w.ts DESC

panels.title: City temperatures, daily average since Jan 2025

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d'), city AS metric, avg(temp_c) AS value
FROM weather_current
WHERE city IN ('Amsterdam','Rotterdam','The Hague','Utrecht','Eindhoven') AND ts >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d'), city AS metric, avg(aqi_eu) AS value
FROM weather_current
WHERE city IN ('Amsterdam','Rotterdam','The Hague','Utrecht','Eindhoven') AND ts >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='cpi_index' AND source='cbs'
  AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs' AND indicator IN ('cpi_inflation_pct', 'food_cpi_inflation_pct')
  AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1
SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='food_cpi_index' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='house_sales_count' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='house_price_index' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='house_price_avg_eur' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy tariffs, incl. VAT (variable contract price)
panels.description: Gas in EUR/m3, electricity in EUR/kWh — different units on one axis, use the legend.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs'
  AND indicator IN ('gas_variable_price_eur_m3', 'electricity_variable_price_eur_kwh')
  AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='unemployment_rate_pct' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 10-year government bond yield
panels.description: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='gov_bond_10y_pct' AND source='ecb' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

panels.title: FX: EUR/USD
panels.description: EUR/USD and EUR/TRY are split into two panels — TRY's scale (50+) would flatten USD's (~1.15) on one shared axis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, 1/rate AS "EUR/USD" FROM fx_rate
WHERE base='USD' AND quote='EUR' AND source='frankfurter' AND ts >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time, rate AS "EUR/TRY" FROM fx_rate
WHERE base='EUR' AND quote='TRY' AND source='tcmb' AND ts >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, indicator AS metric, value FROM price_index
WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND source='cbs'
  AND indicator IN ('tourism_guests_thousands', 'tourism_overnight_stays_thousands')
  AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date) ORDER BY 1

SELECT period_date AS time, value FROM price_index WHERE country_iso3='NLD' AND indicator='tourism_occupancy_pct' AND source='cbs' AND period_date >= '2025-01-01' AND $__timeFilter(period_date)  ORDER BY 1

options.content:
**Sources:** CBS (Statistics Netherlands) StatLine open data — CPI, food CPI, house prices,
energy tariffs, unemployment, tourism. ECB Data Portal — 10-year government bond yield.
Frankfurter/TCMB — FX. Open-Meteo — weather and air quality for Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht, Eindhoven.
All free, no API key. Data from 2025-01-01 onward where available; CBS monthly series lag
by a few weeks to a few months, which is normal for official statistics, not missing data.

**Not included, checked and found unavailable for free:** road traffic congestion (NDW's
open data is a live snapshot only, no historical query API; no public API found for ANWB
either) and current mortgage/deposit interest rates (no free NL-specific API found).
